meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调度一批互相依赖的子任务,按阶段依次执行,失败自动重试补救
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要让一大批有先后依赖的任务分成多个子任务按序跑完
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must fan out many interdependent tasks across child workers in order

howto.what: Claude 会把你交代的多步任务拆成带依赖关系的节点图,通过 workflow 工具按波次并行执行:前置节点先跑,依赖满足后再跑下游。单个节点失败可单独重试或改指令,已完成的节点结果保留。
howto.when: 当你提到 mass-ulw、任务 DAG 或需要按依赖排序的 fan-out 作业(某些任务必须等别的先完成)时触发。任务彼此完全独立时,用普通并行 task 更简单。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这次重构拆成 DAG:先审计文档,再改写,最后校验。
say.note: 会定义节点图并按波次执行。

say.text: 重试刚才失败的 lint 节点,并改成跳过 vendored 目录。
say.note: 只重跑该节点,已完成节点复用。

say.text: 用 amend 让校验节点依赖改写节点,其余不动。
say.note: 只有改动节点及其下游会重跑。

howto.what_en: Claude turns your request into a dependency graph of nodes, run via the workflow tool in parallel waves: nodes with done prerequisites go first. A failed node can be retried or steered alone; finished nodes keep their results.
howto.when_en: Fires when you ask for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or staged fan-out where some tasks must wait on others. For fully independent workers, plain parallel task spawns are simpler.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to turn this refactor into a DAG: audit docs, rewrite, then verify.
say_en.note: Defines the node graph and runs it in waves.

say_en.text: Retry the failed lint node and tell it to skip the vendored dir.
say_en.note: Only that node reruns; finished nodes are reused.

say_en.text: Amend the run so verify depends on rewrite, keeping everything else.
say_en.note: Only changed nodes and their dependents rerun.
